title: MAKER
description: A cross-platform DIY blueprint and creator platform connecting woodworkers with trusted makers.

roadmap.title: Turborepo Scaffolding & Unified Domain Models
roadmap.summary: Monorepo architecture sharing core TypeScript types, Zod validators, and Supabase database clients across web and mobile.
deliverables: Turborepo setup with 5 packages (2 apps + 3 shared libraries)
Relational Supabase PostgreSQL schema with RLS security policies
Shared Zod blueprint schemas and PL/pgSQL rating triggers

roadmap.title: Next.js Web Blueprint Discovery & Creator Studio
roadmap.summary: Web-based blueprint authoring, video step embedding, cut list calculators, and community reviews.
deliverables: Cloudflare Pages production deployment & continuous delivery pipeline
Interactive cut list optimizer and lumber yield calculator
User reviews, build photos, and community question threads

roadmap.title: Expo Mobile Offline Workshop Mode
roadmap.summary: High-contrast workshop mode, offline step caching, and hardware bluetooth tool pairing.
deliverables: Hands-free voice step advancement in sawdust environments
Interactive bill-of-materials tool checklist with store deep links
